sources.title: Safe Kernel Extensions Without Run-Time Checking — Proof-Carrying Code
sources.location: Section Proof-Carrying Code, first two paragraphs
sources.source_claim_paraphrase: The consumer specifies a policy and code interface. The producer supplies code with a formal safety proof; the consumer validates that proof before executing the associated code.
sources.local_inference: Separate generation of static evidence from checking that a particular executable and its dependencies are still the evidence subject. A reusable Python source audit must state its limited policy and bind the exact implementation; a cached success boolean alone is insufficient.
sources.non_transferable_claim: Our AST checks, hashes and finite regression tests are not a formal PCC safety proof. The paper does not establish our Python mutable-global or private-state assumptions. It cannot justify removing any dynamic tray, ACK, source freshness, wire or deadline guard.

sources.title: An Introduction to Partial Evaluation
sources.author: Neil D. Jones
sources.location: Sections1.1–1.2, printed480–482; Section2.3, printed485; PDF pages0–2 and5
sources.source_claim_paraphrase: Specialization evaluates computations determined by static input and retains operations that depend on dynamic input. Correctness requires the specialized and original computations to agree. Static input changes require a new specialization. Binding-time analysis must justify which operations can be eliminated, and specialization must terminate.
sources.local_inference: Treat source-derived action-use analysis and control-flow reconstruction as possible static work only after measuring it and enumerating all code, defaults, closures, MRO and global dependencies. Live continuation, supplied observations and timing remain dynamic. Charge specialization and invalidation checks to their actual lifecycle rather than hiding setup in a warm-call number.
sources.non_transferable_claim: This project currently performs manual source transformations, not a verified automatic partial evaluator. The survey is design motivation, not proof of conformance, a claimed speedup or a complete100ms certificate.
